szoveg_eredeti:
Join Kling AI during Adobe MAX 2026 in Miami!
From November 10-12, we’re bringing together creative professionals, brands, and agencies across three events:

🎤 Nov 10 | 5:00-8:00 PM | Industry Forum
Join Adobe’s Elissa Levine and Kling AI’s Zheru Liu for a discussion on how AI video can expand creative possibilities for brands and agencies.
RSVP for the industry forum: https://luma.com/0gs7m0sv

🎬 Nov 12 | 10:00-10:30 AM | Creative Park Talk
Discover how Kling 4.0 can help turn creative concepts into motion at the Discovery Stage.

✨ Nov 10–12 | Kling Booth #1003
Visit us at Booth #1003 to explore creative work and meet our team.
See you in Miami! #KlingAI #Kling4 #AdobeMAX2026
